$comment: Ranked press inventory. Machine-written by scripts/press-scan.mjs, human-correctable. Anything with "locked": true survives a rescan untouched — that is how you keep a hand-written verdict. See README.md for the scoring model and the attribution tiers. Every url here returned a live response when it was added; `http` records what it returned.

summary.note: No third-party article names GHXSTSHIP. Searches for the brand return only our own site. Everything below is coverage OF THE WORK, not of us — useful as proof the projects are real and notable, not as a citation that we delivered them. Read the attribution field before quoting anything.

polymarket-free-grocery-store.note: By far the most-covered entry, and the most careful to use. The activation itself drew national pickup, but a meaningful slice of it is politically framed or skeptical. Quote the service and the donation, not the crowd scenes.

l-acoustics-dj.title: L-Acoustics DJ
l-acoustics-dj.note: Was 'none-found' on the first sweep because the queries said 'sound system install'. The trades cover it as L-Acoustics DJ, spatial audio and the S3QU3NC3 stage, and there is a lot of it. Best-covered entry for the Technology vertical, and the closest the inventory gets to trade-press proof — but no piece names an integrator, only L-Acoustics and III Points.

items.why: Live-sound trade of record. The single best link for this entry: right outlet, right audience, right deployment.
items.headline: L-Acoustics DJ Deployed at Miami's III Points Festival

items.why: Mix carried it too. Two independent trades on the same install is the strongest technical credibility we have anywhere.
items.headline: L-Acoustics DJ Makes Its US Festival Debut at Miami's III Points

items.why: AV trade pickup.
items.headline: L-Acoustics DJ Makes U.S. Festival Debut at Miami's III Points with Immersive Spatial Audio

items.why: The manufacturer's own case study on the exact deployment: III Points 2025, Oct 17-18, Mana Wynwood, L-Acoustics DJ on S3QU3NC3. Read in full — GHXSTSHIP is not named, and no integrator is credited at all.
items.verifiedBy: rendered in-browser 2026-07-27; page is JS-built and returns only nav chrome to a plain fetch
items.headline: L-Acoustics DJ: Bringing Real-Time Spatial Audio to Miami's III Points Festival Sound System

items.why: The press release the trades ran from. Source of the S3QU3NC3 spec: eight hangs of L2D in 8.1, four frontal stacks of three KS28 cardioid, six X12 plus two KS21i overhead.
items.headline: L-Acoustics DJ Makes Its US Festival Debut at Miami's III Points

items.why: Third-party editorial rather than vendor marketing, and it is artist testimony from the stage itself. Also dates the arc: L-ISA on the 444 stage in 2024, L-Acoustics DJ on S3QU3NC3 in 2025, L-Acoustics on every stage for eight straight years.
items.quote: For nearly a decade, III Points has treated sound system design as a core part of its identity, not an afterthought.
items.headline: Kujo on Performing at III Points With L-Acoustics DJ

items.why: Institute for Theatre Technology carried it — useful when the audience is institutional rather than commercial.

black-coffee-race-track.title: Black Coffee at the Race Track
black-coffee-race-track.note: Was 'none-found' because the queries said Club Space. The event was at HIALEAH PARK RACETRACK on 28 March 2026, presented by Club Space, with Black Coffee, Carlita and Kaz James — first dance-music event ever held at the 1922 track. The site's card currently names Club Space as the venue, which is wrong; see the flag on the work page.

items.why: Event-production trade covering Miami Music Week 2026 activations. Same outlet that carried Heineken Turn 4 — the pattern worth leaning into.
items.headline: Inside Miami Music Week 2026

items.why: ~30-photo gallery of the night. Miami's society and nightlife photo agency — for this kind of work their galleries are the most reusable asset in the inventory, not just a citation.
items.quote: The historic Hialeah Park racetrack came to life last night Black Coffee, Carlita, and Kaz James, presented by Club Space.
items.headline: Miami Music Week 2026: Black Coffee & Carlita at the Racetrack
